description: Brand/model knowledge that makes protocols product-specific without an LLM. A profile applies when all its `match` conditions hold: `categories` (inspection category), `text` (regex over name, brand and model), `notText` (regex that must not match). A profile can set `attributes`, `include` library parameter ids, add inline `parameters`, and `override` library parameters (`instructions` replaces, `appendInstructions` adds). `reason` is recorded on every parameter it touches. Keep claims here factual and model-specific; unknown models simply match no profile.

profiles.reason: Apple devices can stay locked to the previous owner through Activation Lock / Find My.

appendInstructions: Confirm Find My is turned off and the device has been removed from the previous owner's Apple Account

profiles.reason: iOS reports battery capacity and non-genuine parts in Settings.

instructions: Open Settings > Battery > Battery Health (& Charging)
Record Maximum Capacity and whether a service message or 'Unknown part' is shown
Compare Maximum Capacity with the declared battery health
Open Settings > General > About and read the Parts and Service History section where shown
Record any part listed as 'Unknown Part' or replaced

appendInstructions: Confirm the IMEI in Settings > General > About matches the one shown by *#06#

profiles.reason: iPhone X and later (except SE models) unlock with Face ID.
iPhone SE and iPhone 8 and earlier unlock with the Touch ID home button.

appendInstructions: Check the Home button clicks and returns to the home screen

profiles.reason: US-model iPhone 14 and later have no physical SIM tray and use eSIM only.

appendInstructions: If the phone has no SIM tray (US model), test network registration with an eSIM instead

profiles.reason: macOS reports battery cycle count and condition, and Apple Diagnostics is built in.

parameters.title: Apple Diagnostics
instructions: Shut down, then start into Apple Diagnostics (Apple silicon: hold the power button until startup options appear, then press Command-D; Intel: hold D at start-up)
Record the result and any reference codes
Open System Settings > General > About > System Report > Power
Record Cycle Count, Condition and Maximum Capacity
Compare with any declared figure

appendInstructions: Confirm no firmware password is set (Intel models) and Activation Lock Status reads Disabled in System Report > Hardware

profiles.reason: MacBook Pro 14/16 (2021 and later) have MagSafe 3 charging, HDMI, an SDXC slot, Touch ID and a mini-LED display.

parameters.title: MagSafe Charging
parameters.description: Confirm the MagSafe 3 port charges the laptop.
instructions: Connect a MagSafe 3 cable and confirm it attaches magnetically
Confirm the connector LED lights and the battery charges
Also confirm charging over a USB-C port

appendInstructions: On a dark background with bright objects, check for excessive blooming on the mini-LED display
Test the HDMI output with an external display

profiles.reason: Dell laptops carry a Service Tag and built-in pre-boot diagnostics; business models are often enrolled in a company's device management.

parameters.title: Dell Pre-boot Diagnostics
instructions: Restart and press F12 at the Dell logo
Choose Diagnostics and let the quick test complete
Record the result and any error codes
Read the Service Tag on the bottom label
Confirm the same Service Tag shows in BIOS setup (F2 at start-up)
Photograph the label

appendInstructions: Confirm no BIOS administrator or system password is set (F2 setup)
Confirm the laptop is not enrolled in a previous organisation's device management (Windows: Settings > Accounts > Access work or school)

profiles.reason: ThinkPads have a TrackPoint pointing stick and physical buttons above the touchpad.

parameters.title: TrackPoint
parameters.description: Test the TrackPoint and its three buttons.
instructions: Move the cursor with the TrackPoint in every direction
Test the three buttons above the touchpad, including middle-button scroll
parameters.expectedResult: TrackPoint moves smoothly without drift; buttons respond.

profiles.reason: Android devices keep Factory Reset Protection tied to the previous Google account.

appendInstructions: Confirm the previous Google account is removed so Factory Reset Protection will not lock the device

profiles.reason: Samsung devices also lock through the Samsung account and Find My Mobile.

appendInstructions: Confirm the Samsung account is signed out and Find My Mobile is off

profiles.reason: The Innova is a 7/8-seat MPV with second-row slide/tumble seats and rear roof AC vents.

parameters.title: Second-Row Seats & Third-Row Access
parameters.description: Check the second-row seats slide and tumble so passengers can reach the third row.
instructions: Slide and recline each second-row seat
Tumble the second-row seat and confirm it locks back into place
Check the third-row seats and their belts
parameters.expectedResult: Seats move and lock securely; third row accessible.

appendInstructions: Check the rear roof-mounted AC vents and the rear blower control
If the selector has a manual (+/−) mode, check it changes gear indication while stationary

profiles.reason: Passenger buses carry commercial permits and emergency exits.

parameters.title: Emergency Exits
parameters.description: Check emergency exits are marked, unobstructed and operable.
instructions: Locate every emergency exit and window hammer
Confirm exits are marked and not blocked
Open each emergency door or hatch while stationary and close it again
parameters.expectedResult: All emergency exits marked, clear and operable.

appendInstructions: Confirm the contract-carriage / tourist permit covers passenger hire

profiles.reason: Banquet chairs are hired in lots, stacked for transport, and handled most at the backrest and legs.

appendInstructions: Check the backrest top and legs closely — the most handled areas — for chipped paint or plating
Sit-test sampled chairs gently; check the seat frame and back spindles for movement

profiles.reason: LED walls are built from modules that fail individually.

parameters.title: LED Modules & Uniformity
parameters.description: Check every module lights and matches its neighbours.
instructions: Display full-screen white, red, green and blue
Look for dead modules, dead pixels and modules that differ in colour or brightness
Check module edges are aligned with no visible seams
parameters.expectedResult: All modules lit, uniform and aligned.
